# Fictional group and period comparison

Eight complete incident histories exercise two explicitly named overlapping groups, missing opening context versus literal Unknown, different supports, exact four-hour equality, cross-period resolution and a recent case with one hour of follow-up at the declared cutoff. The two groups are literal membership sets: the reference is not substituted with the rest of the parent. Their record counts overlap and cannot be added as a partition.

Period membership uses case starts in half-open intervals and retains complete histories outside the interval. G07 starts in the recent period and resolves after its end; both records remain. G06 has no recorded resolution and inadequate four-hour follow-up. G04 and G08 retain missing opening context despite later values. Neither association nor missing recorded resolution establishes business outcome or causation.

`expected.json` is a literal oracle for real operation acceptance once the comparison endpoints exist. Input consistency alone does not qualify comparison or Method scoring.
